0.masked: Indonesian undergraduates end their degree with a <1>skripsi</1>: a thesis whose methods and results chapters follow the conventions of the study programme, whose literature review must cite real sources, whose statistics are computed in code, and whose language must follow the national spelling rules. Which large language model (LLM) should students, supervisors and the tools built for them use? We introduce AcademicBench, ⟦0⟧ items in eight tasks taken from this workflow---chapter outlines per programme, methodology questions, methods extraction from real theses, grounded literature reviews, reference lists, formal Indonesian, data-analysis code and LaTeX---scored deterministically wherever possible, with LLM judges of other vendors for prose, and with the served model, tokens, cost and GPU energy recorded for every call. Evaluating ⟦1⟧ economy- and standard-tier API models of the GitHub Copilot SDK and ⟦2⟧ local open-weight models (⟦3⟧ API calls, US⟦4⟧ in total), we find no significant difference among the three best API models (overall ⟦5⟧--⟦6⟧), while cost spans two orders of magnitude: a model ⟦7⟧ below the leader costs ⟦8⟧ times less per item. Methodology questions and formal Indonesian are near ceiling for API models; producing artefacts separates them. ⟦9⟧--⟦10⟧ of the references the API models listed are not found in Crossref, and ⟦11⟧--⟦12⟧ are found neither there nor in doi.org, Scopus or OpenAlex, against ⟦13⟧--⟦14⟧ for local models. The best local model (⟦15⟧) stays below the weakest API model (⟦16⟧) and is not cheaper per item at rental prices; an Indonesian-tuned 9B model did not write formal Indonesian better than a newer general model of similar size. The three judges agree (Krippendorff's ⟦17⟧) and track the deterministic checks (⟦18⟧ across models), and the SDK reported the requested model as the serving model for every call. Code, public items, per-item scores and the cost-gated runner are released.

Ketiga juri sepakat (Krippendorff's ⟦17⟧) dan melacak pemeriksaan deterministik (⟦18⟧ di seluruh model), dan SDK melaporkan model yang diminta sebagai model yang melayani untuk setiap panggilan. Kode, butir publik, skor per-butir dan runner bergerbang biaya dirilis.

37.masked: For each of 20 topics the model lists five references with DOI and is told that fewer is better than invented. Each reference is looked up in Crossref⟦0⟧, the largest registration agency for journal and proceedings DOIs: first by the DOI given, then by title and first author, with paper-agent's matching rule⟦1⟧: title similarity ⟦2⟧ (Crossref's title and subtitle joined), year ⟦3⟧ of any of the work's publication dates, and first-author surname; arXiv DOIs are checked against arXiv. Crossref answers other than ``found'' or ``not found'' (rate limits, server errors) leave the item unscored rather than wrong. Credit is 1 for an existing work with the correct DOI, 0.75 without a DOI, 0.5 with a wrong DOI and 0 if the work is not found; the score divides by five, so abstaining costs as much as an unverifiable reference. Because a real work can be missing from Crossref, an audit looks every miss up again with the same rule---a given DOI at doi.org (all registration agencies), the title in Scopus and in OpenAlex⟦4⟧; Semantic Scholar refused our requests---and classifies it as found, matching only a real title, or found nowhere. 49.masked: AcademicBench measures several things that Indonesian thesis work needs from an LLM---outlines that fit the study programme, faithful use of sources, real references, formal Indonesian, correct analysis code and compilable LaTeX---together with what each answer costs and which model produced it. Across ⟦0⟧ models, the three best API models are not significantly different while the cost of the API models spans two orders of magnitude, references separate the models most, and on average local models trail on every task, least on formal Indonesian. The practical advice is to choose by price among the leaders, to verify every reference, and to use local models where privacy requires it. The kit evaluates any further model with one command; the premium tier, high reasoning effort, repeated runs and a human check of the judges and keys are the next steps.

out.draft: AcademicBench mengukur beberapa hal yang dibutuhkan karya skripsi Indonesia dari sebuah model bahasa besar---kerangka yang sesuai dengan program studi, penggunaan sumber yang setia, rujukan yang nyata, bahasa Indonesia baku, kode analisis yang benar dan LaTeX yang dapat dikompilasi---bersama dengan biaya tiap jawaban dan model yang menghasilkannya. Stabilitas peringkat dan selisih berpasangan setiap model terhadap model teratas diperoleh dari 1⟦3⟧000 sampel semacam itu dari bootstrap terstratifikasi per tugas, yang memberi bobot pada tugas-tugas sebagaimana dilakukan oleh skor keseluruhan; suatu selisih disebut signifikan ketika intervalnya tidak mencakup nol. Setiap model dibandingkan hanya dengan model teratas, dan interval tidak disesuaikan untuk multiplikitas.
